description: Source code for a Python script that compares image files or APKs by computing SHA-1 hashes, with support for allowlists, skipping signing keys, and handling zip files. It includes functions for hashing, filtering, and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: silent_call
methods.description: Executes a command suppressing stdout and stderr, returns True if command succeeds.

methods.name: sha1sum
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 hash of a file.

methods.name: sha1sum_without_signing_key
methods.description: Calculates SHA-1 hash of APK contents excluding META-INF directory.

methods.name: strip_and_sha1sum
methods.description: Strips ELF file sections and computes SHA-1 hash.

methods.name: make_filter_from_allowlists
methods.description: Creates a filter function based on allowlist files to skip certain files or lines.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to compare files across targets, generate CSV reports.

methods.name: main_with_zip
methods.description: Handles zipped files, extracts and then calls main for comparison.
